description.value: The Northway Motor Inn is a 43-room motor inn in Dease Lake sitting along the Stewart-Cassiar Highway (Hwy 37), one of only two BC routes leading to the Yukon and Alaska — making it a key resupply and rest stop for cyclists tackling this remote corridor. The hotel serves as a practical base for the surrounding wilderness, including the Stikine River country and Cassiar Mountains. The Info & Tips page offers unusually candid travel advice for the highway, including the complete absence of cell service between Kitwanga and the Alaska Highway Junction.

address.value: 81 Boulder Avenue, Dease Lake, BC V0C 1L0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides comprehensive amenity and service information. Guest laundry is explicitly listed under Services; high-speed WiFi is listed under Room amenities and corroborated by OSM's internet_access=wlan tag. No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, drying area, e-bike charging, pump, or tools anywhere on the site. A significant address discrepancy exists: OSM lists '158 Boulder Street' but the website consistently states '81 Boulder Avenue, Dease Lake, BC V0C 1L0' across every page — both the street number and street name differ, so contact_confirmed.address is set to false and flagged as a concern.
concerns: Address discrepancy: OSM lists '158 Boulder Street' but the website consistently shows '81 Boulder Avenue, Dease Lake, BC V0C 1L0' across all pages — both the street number and street name differ. OSM address should be verified and corrected.
On-site pizzeria is noted as '*currently closed' on the website; food options in Dease Lake are limited and some have seasonal hours.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating hotel in a remote stretch of the Stewart-Cassiar Highway — an important waypoint for any touring cyclist on this route.
enrichment_extras.notes: The hotel's Info & Tips page explicitly notes there is NO cell service in Dease Lake or along Hwy 37 from Kitwanga to the Alaska Highway Junction — highly relevant safety information for cyclists on this route. WiFi at the hotel is the only connectivity option.
